# Ebmeyer Consulting

> AI strategy and enablement for established entrepreneurs, solopreneurs and
> founders. Run by Nadine Ebmeyer from Cham ZG, Switzerland, in German and
> English. The work combines strategy consulting with building tailored AI
> assistants, keeping people — not tools — at the centre.

Ebmeyer Consulting is a Swiss sole proprietorship (Einzelunternehmen),
UID CHE-456.292.561. Nadine Ebmeyer brings 21+ years of international
experience — luxury hospitality, transformation consulting at KPMG, and COO
and CEO roles in health-tech and fintech — and has built over 50 individual
AI assistants for clients.

Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute intro call. Prices are not
published; they are discussed on that call.

## Programmes

- [Souverän mit KI (DE)](https://ebmeyer-consulting.ch/de/souveraen-mit-ki/): For established entrepreneurs and solopreneurs. Two phases over 4–6 weeks — assessment and base set-up, then build and enablement. Ends with the client owning their own AI assistant and a clear strategy.
- [Confident with AI (EN)](https://ebmeyer-consulting.ch/en/confident-with-ai/): English version of the above.
- [Souverän gründen (DE)](https://ebmeyer-consulting.ch/de/souveraen-gruenden/): For founders. Three phases over 12 weeks — clarity and positioning, hypotheses and business cases, then plan to build. Founding with a validated strategy and an AI assistant from day one.
- [Founding with Confidence (EN)](https://ebmeyer-consulting.ch/en/founding-with-confidence/): English version of the above.

## Main pages

- [Homepage (DE)](https://ebmeyer-consulting.ch/de/): German homepage, canonical entry point.
- [Homepage (EN)](https://ebmeyer-consulting.ch/en/): English homepage.

## What clients get

- A personal AI assistant that automates recurring work in client communication, marketing or internal processes.
- A data-informed strategy for understanding their audience and making decisions.
- Their own AI toolbox — the tools that matter, and the ability to use them.
